user.title: Smoker dashboard
user.description: Add the ESPHome Smoker device first; then run Install the Smoker package (Developer tools > Actions, smoker.install_package). This adds the Smoker page to the sidebar; it reads the ESPHome smoker controller's entities.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Smoker dashboard is already set up.

package_not_installed.title: The Smoker package isn't installed
package_not_installed.description: The smoker's phone alerts, AI advisor and voice commands live in the Smoker package, and /config/packages/smoker.yaml isn't there. Go to Developer tools > Actions, run "Install the Smoker package" (smoker.install_package) with your phone's notify action, then restart Home Assistant.
